fit_reason: Whole 2017 Dodge Grand Caravan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Light dust and road film on the lower doors and rocker panels along the driver side
Headlight lenses look slightly hazy, mostly the passenger side
Black lower front bumper trim and grille surround look a little faded
Paint on the hood and roof reflects reasonably but looks a bit flat in the low evening light
Photos taken at dusk on gravel with other cars crowding the frame, and only one interior shot of the gauges, so interior condition can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Grand Caravan. The red paint is in decent shape, but the headlights look a little hazy and there's some road film along the lower doors. We do mobile pre-sale details that come to you, including a wash and wax, headlight restoration and interior cleaning, which would make it photograph sharper for buyers. Would you like a quote?
